metadata.title: Bay Area Seafood Foraging Spots
metadata.description: Recreational seafood foraging locations in Bay Area counties (San Francisco, San Mateo, Marin, Sonoma) with seafood type, license, season and restriction info. Includes no-take MPA reference points.
metadata.coordinate_note: Coordinates are approximate (hand-placed at the access point / pier / flat), WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Verify against MPA boundary polygons from CDFW before publishing.
metadata.regulation_note: Rules summarized from news and angler sources, not official regulation text. Seasons, limits and closures change (e.g. Dungeness season delays, CDPH biotoxin advisories). Check CDFW ocean sport fishing regulations and the CDPH Shellfish Information Line (800-553-4133) before harvesting.

field_definitions.source: One citation per line: Page title | Author/publisher | URL. Listed publisher/site substitutes for an unrecorded individual author; Not recorded means neither is identified. Science Insights is identified from its source URL. Titles and URLs are from the existing reference list, not newly verified page metadata. Original S1-S30 keys remain in metadata.sources. Each citation ends with Accessed November 2026, the access month supplied by the project owner; this is not a new verification of source pages or regulations.

properties.name: Pacifica Municipal Pier
properties.species: Dungeness crab, rock crab (brown, red, yellow)
properties.season: Dungeness: roughly November to June/July (opener can be delayed; check CDFW). Rock crab: year-round.
properties.limits: Dungeness min 5.75 in carapace; rock crab min 4 in, limit 35
properties.restrictions: Ocean-side pier, so Dungeness may be kept. Best at high tide in calm seas.

properties.name: Pillar Point reef
properties.species: California sea mussel (primary); also turban snails, sea urchins, crabs
properties.season: Mussels: open for consumption Nov 1 to Apr 30; CDPH quarantine May 1 to Oct 31. Best at minus low tides.
properties.limits: Mussels 10 lb/day in shell; hands only, no tools
properties.restrictions: Within/adjacent to Pillar Point SMCA and next to Montara SMR (no take). Heavily harvested; beds reported depleted. Check CDPH/San Mateo County mussel sampling before eating.

properties.limits: Keep the first 10 of each species dug; no size limit for these species
properties.restrictions: Best clam island reachable by boat at low tide. Private campground access (fee). Check CDPH bivalve advisories.
